a warm caramel complexion, early 20s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob dark brown hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 34%, 58% and 80% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out leaf-like shapes. Her bust carries a large mandala on each breast, concentric rings of petals and fine linework in deep indigo, ivory white and gold around a solid gold centre that fully and opaquely covers her nipple and areola, spreading outward over the curve of her bust. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries thick impasto oil paint with heavy palette-knife ridges. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Klimt style spirals and mosaic ornament. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Kandinsky style circles, triangles and sweeping lines. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

ONE woman only.
